description: One decision (vote) of a rikma as structure: what it proposes, the round on the table, who has signed it and who has not yet, and the deadline - when the deadline passes with no counter-proposal, silence approves it. Members only; a sale-holder claim is visible only to its two parties. Read-only: it never votes. To sign, discuss or counter, give the user `url`. The decision ids come from getMyUpdatesTool. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getDecisionTool
name: getDecisionTool
